items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: On the same bill were ... Dave Shepherd, clarinet

ctx.x: The next interesting thing of 1973 was the jazz festivals of Montreux, Switzerland and Pescara in Italy, a concert in Modena, also in Italy, and the festival of wine in Lilly's home town, Neuchatel.

I played the Montreux festival the 4th of July with my friend Guy Lafitte the tenor sax, Daniel Humair, drums, and a native of Switzerland, a fine young bass man named Jack Sewing, born in Holland, and Marc Hemmerler; also of Swiss nationality. On the same bill were Stephane Grappelli, Teddy Wilson, Barney Kessel, Freddy Randall, to Danny Moss, tenor sax Dave Shepherd, clarinet, Dave Hewitt, trumpet, Brian Lemon, piano, Kenny Baldock, bass, and Johnny Richardson, drums.
The Pescara festival I played on the 14th of July. Lily and I had spent 3 days in the dream city of Bologna before going to Pescara.
